name: Manage Agents
description: List MyAgent agents, or add/update an agent. Use action='list' to get every agent (id, name, tools). Use action='save' to create a new agent or update an existing one from its name, system prompt and the tools it may use.

action.description: 'list' returns all agents; 'save' creates a new agent or updates an existing one.

name.description: Agent display name. Required for 'save'. The agent id is derived from it (slugified) unless 'id' is provided.

system_prompt.description: The agent's system prompt / instructions. Used by 'save'. On update it is only changed when provided.

tools.description: Folder names of the tools the agent may use (e.g. 'web_search', 'file_write', 'browse_web'). Used by 'save'. On update it is only changed when provided.

id.description: Optional explicit agent id. If it matches an existing agent that agent is updated, otherwise a new one is created. Defaults to the slugified name.

copy_from.description: Optional id of an existing agent to clone as the starting point (copies its system_prompt, tools, model, etc.). Any of name/system_prompt/tools/... you also pass then override the copy. Ignored when updating an agent that already exists.

description.description: Optional short description of the agent.

model_id.description: Optional model id to use. Defaults to 'default' (the globally configured default model).

enabled.description: Optional. Whether the agent is enabled (default true).

temperature.description: Optional. Sampling temperature for tool-calling decisions (lower = more deterministic, fewer hallucinations). Omit to leave unchanged.

response_temperature.description: Optional. Sampling temperature for the final answer. Lower it (e.g. 0.2) to reduce made-up content. Omit to leave unchanged.

max_iterations.description: Optional. Max LLM round-trips per turn (default 10). Raise it if the agent needs several tool calls before answering.

max_tool_calls.description: Optional. Hard cap on total tool executions per turn (default 5).
